caveats: The negative-control harness produced two discarded false results before this one. Attempt 1 exited 0 having measured nothing (node_modules was not copied, so npx tsc resolved to a placeholder package). Attempt 2 reported three properties caught at compile, all artifacts of badly written mutations rather than load-bearing code. Both are documented in primitive-hardening.md rather than deleted.

Identifier non-reuse currently holds only while .tailered/ledger-sequence.json survives. Loss after bootstrap is detected and refused, never silently rebuilt, but recovery from canonical rows alone cannot restore identifiers issued to an in-flight run. P0B-12 durable run-start records close this; the scan for them is already implemented and returns nothing until they exist.
writeAtomic does not fsync the temp file or the parent directory, so no P0-B artifact claims power-loss durability. Adding those syncs would modify src/files.ts, which now carries merged P0-A work.
